errors.title: DAG import timeout
causes: expensive top-level code: external calls, big loops, Variable.get
too many DAGs generated per file; check parse-pressure

errors.title: Zombie / undead task
causes: worker killed mid-task (OOM, node loss); scheduler marks zombie
heartbeat config mismatch between worker and scheduler

errors.title: Pool starvation
patterns: re:could not be scheduled|no available slots
causes: pool slots consumed by long-running sensors or retries
deferrable=False tasks holding slots while waiting

errors.title: Scheduler heartbeat / job failure
patterns: re:The scheduler does not appear to be running
causes: scheduler overloaded or crashed; check DAG parse times

errors.title: Task serialization / dependency error
causes: provider package missing or incompatible with Airflow version

errors.title: Triggerer / deferrable failure
causes: triggerer service not running or overloaded
